_doc: Curated overlay for the V5 requirements ledger (SPEC_V5 §27.2). Keys per requirement: owner, profile, stage, code_surfaces, scenarios (E/C/D ids added beyond the spec's section anchors), gate, evidence_type (DOC/CODE/LOCAL/BENCH/INDEPENDENT), executed_evidence (named executed checks/runs — required for locally_measured/qualified), implementation_status, qualification_status, blocker, note. spec_sha256 is refreshed by `tools/gen_v5_ledger.py --write`.

V5-00.01.note: Authority clause over the spec file itself — nothing implementable. Still binding: SPEC_V5 remains an unapproved proposal; SPEC_V6 R1 authorizes implementation only, never publication/provider activation.

V5-00.02.note: Amendment-binding governance rule — contract text, no code surface. Binding as inherited context: V6-00.08 keeps unamended V5 MUSTs in force.

V5-00.03.note: Ledger rejects duplicate/unknown ids — the V5-NN.MM / ENN / G5-NN namespaces cannot rename or overwrite predecessor requirements or evidence.

V5-00.04.note: MUST/SHOULD discipline is specification-language convention — enforced by the ledger's honesty rules (locally_measured/qualified rejected without executed evidence), not by code.

V5-00.05.note: Two-axis status model implemented: rows seed planned/not_run; locally_measured/qualified rejected without named executed evidence.

V5-00.06.note: Scope statement (focused delta, not a kernel rewrite) — descriptive, not implementable.

V5-00.07.note: Part I/Part II structure statement — descriptive, not implementable.

V5-01.01.note: Memory() -> add -> search -> inspect/forget is the shipped surface.

V5-01.02.note: Local-first: the entire v5 suite runs on tmp_path SQLite stores, stdlib-only, no GPU/daemon/network.

V5-01.03.note: Scenario coverage drives the public facade — no eval-only API or manual DB edits.

V5-07.01.note: Atomic commit: source bytes + attribution + screening disposition + idempotency receipt + obligations in one tx.

V5-07.02.note: Ack returns after durable acceptance; projection work drains in the managed worker.

V5-07.03.note: Sensitive/zero-retention policy decided before durable writes (_check_retention_policy); e09 passes unmarked — the core.serialize defect it named is fixed, stale xfail removed 2026-09-22. Protected input is never labeled ordinary retained/searchable evidence.

V5-07.04.note: infer=False skips interpretation, not source indexing — raw content stays searchable under the same source identity.

V5-07.05.note: infer=True requests only permitted interpretation; excluded kinds stay source-searchable with explicit derivation state.

V5-07.06.note: Canonical bytes never mutated/discarded (test_canonical_bytes_never_mutated); generated views are replaceable.

V5-07.07.note: Source projection lives in the projection/index ownership boundary via durable jobs — no facade raw-SQL path.

V5-07.08.note: source_lexical_projection binds revision, scope, generation, digest, doc_len, tokenizer version (norm/v1).

V5-07.09.note: Same key+semantics replays the durable outcome; changed bytes/context conflict.

V5-07.11.note: Strict UTF-8 at the boundary; canonical bytes never normalized — search normalization is the pinned norm/v1 projection. Facade NFC-query leg (e11) is xfail-marked but xpassed.

V5-07.12.note: Post-commit loss recoverable via idempotency/receipt lookup; pre-commit backpressure rejects cleanly.

V5-07.13.note: Publication predicate re-verified in-commit: bytes verify, screening done, retention class allowed, no quarantine/suppression/erasure, source-state generation fence (held/suppressed/erased refused).

V5-08.01.note: Session-consistency barrier captures the facade's own adds and awaits their source obligations in one shared budget.

V5-08.02.note: source_lexical_ready is the default visibility obligation; source_vector_ready reported independently (deferred never strands the lexical branch).

V5-08.03.note: after reattaches receipt-based causal deps across processes and reauthorizes them — tokens confer no read authority.

V5-08.04.note: Per-receipt DAG evaluation; a scalar high-water mark cannot mask holes/failures.

V5-08.05.note: One monotonic deadline shared across all awaited receipts — not per-receipt.

V5-08.06.note: Expiry returns eligible results with pending/partial + compact warnings; never fakes read-your-writes.

V5-08.07.note: strict=True raises a typed readiness/deadline error (test_strict_pending_raises); never silently switches to eventual.

V5-08.08.note: consistency='eventual' visibly skips the session barrier (test_eventual_skips_barrier).

V5-08.09.note: Search snapshot taken at/after required projection commits; revocation/holds still override.

V5-08.10.note: Search never drains the global queue; unrelated work cannot be read as this receipt's outcome.

V5-08.11.note: Bounded session-receipt tracking; persisted frontier survives restart.

V5-08.12.note: Source branch fulfills for infer=False/zero-claim inputs; a deferred claim capability never strands source work.

V5-08.14.note: Terminal failure/cancellation/hold/expired consent surface as blocked, never polled forever as ordinary pending — e14 (held write reports blocked, not partial) passes unmarked; stale xfail removed 2026-09-22.

V5-08.15.note: Source obligations recorded independently of the legacy pipeline flag (test_pipeline_false_keeps_source_branch_pending).

V5-08.16.note: source_project/source_embed/source_backfill handlers dispatch through the existing queue; each fulfills only its own capability; permanent errors map to the receipt failure indicator.

V5-08.17.note: Durable backfill plan + resumable cursor commits with its batch; construction enqueues bounded backfill without blocking.

V5-08.18.note: Backfill honors grants/holds/erasure/byte-verify; ambiguous legacy state adopted as recorded/unresolved, never inferred approval.

V5-08.19.note: Opaque per-session id bound to store/principal/namespace; committed session state survives restart.

V5-09.01.note: worker='managed' acquires the store-bounded drain owner; pending obligations resume on reopen.

V5-09.02.note: Ref-counted shared worker per store identity — no thread-per-request, no fifth queue.

V5-09.03.note: worker='external' starts no helper and reports external ownership of progress.

V5-09.04.note: Durable leases/generation fences/idempotent coordinator effects; explicit permitted job set (remote/optional kinds never leased).

V5-09.05.note: privacy_control lane drains ahead of ordinary work (test_privacy_lane_drains_ahead_of_ordinary).

V5-09.06.note: Worker errors/backlog/queue pressure queryable via status() (test_status_shape_and_no_foreign_data, test_close_reports_pending_backlog).

V5-09.07.note: close fences in-flight calls, detaches worker ownership, honest CloseReport; releasing one owner never stops a sibling's worker.

V5-09.08.note: Worker owns its own Store connection; missed deadline leaves non-callable 'closing' state with honest report.

V5-09.09.note: Context-manager cleanup preserves primary exceptions; repeated close is safe.

V5-09.10.note: Forked child rejects inherited live objects (test_forked_child_rejects_calls, test_fork_inherited_handle_is_inert). e20 stays xfail-marked but xpassed this run — the child-hang defect it named appears fixed; marker should be revisited.

V5-09.11.note: SIGKILL/restart preserves acknowledged evidence; queued/leased jobs resume or are fenced+reclaimed.

V5-09.12.note: Cooperative cancellation/deadline bounds on drain and close; no model/network op holds the write tx.

V5-09.13.note: Worker leases only enrolled namespaces under persisted per-job authority (test_unenrolled_namespace_is_never_leased).

V5-09.14.note: Synchronized session-frontier/close state; concurrent add/search supported on one facade.

V5-10.01.note: Consumer route is a policy of the consolidated engine — facade owns no scorer/quote-reader/packer.

V5-10.02.note: Default channels: lexical BM25 + hashing similarity + exact identifier/entity postings; deterministic signals reorder only.

V5-10.04.note: Duplicate links land, group identity exists, and facade search delivers collapsed_duplicates/corroboration on hits (E24 now passes on quiet tree).

V5-10.05.note: Identifier-sensitive queries preserve case/punctuation/version; similarity cannot substitute a near identifier.

V5-10.06.note: Eligibility-aware iteration continues past ineligible candidates — no fixed top-N-then-filter.

V5-10.07.note: Class-aware eligibility/statistics: known-at/historical requests exclude future rows.

V5-10.08.note: limit counts logical groups; default budget 8 groups / 6000 serialized bytes (e63 asserts byte budget).

V5-10.09.note: Missing controls fail closed; missing projections report unavailable, never silently 'complete'.

V5-10.10.note: Routes identify policy/artifact generation (ranking/v1, encoder pins) for authorized diagnostics.

V5-11.01.note: Indexes/statistics are eligibility-constrained; foreign-scope changes leave authorized order/scores untouched.

V5-11.02.note: BM25 statistics materialize over the full eligible corpus (N/df/avgdl over E) — candidate-set stats fail the oracle test.

V5-11.03.note: Ineligible rows contribute nothing to order, scores, or completion claims.

V5-11.04.note: Top-N-subset statistics never labeled exact; eligible-corpus materialization is the only scored path.

V5-11.05.note: One eligibility/statistics materialization per snapshot; indexed doc lengths/postings batched (SourceLaneStats).

V5-11.06.note: Cache fingerprint binds caller class, scope, purpose, verbs, epochs, and projection generation — authorization-equivalent keys exercised via the e47/e48 family (a hold between recalls is observed, never hidden by a cache hit).

V5-11.07.note: Where equivalence is unproven the route computes current eligible statistics or reports incomplete/unavailable.

V5-11.08.note: Cross-scope/alias union is explicit, authorized per scope, and uses eligible-union statistics.

V5-11.09.note: Unauthorized rows never consume candidate caps or bias explored postings.

V5-11.10.note: Generation-fenced atomic publication (control_version fence, pinned-generation-ahead refusal, FTS shadow replaced atomically). e31 stays xfail-marked but xpassed this run — stale marker.

V5-11.12.note: Ineligible rows cannot influence metadata/warnings — hidden members leak nothing through counts or flags.

V5-12.01.note: Bounded exact vector scan over source_vectors is the oracle/fallback; encoder identity/generation pinned per row.

V5-12.02.note: Conditional on ANN adoption — no ANN index exists and the exact eligible scan is the only vector path, so the build/incremental/maintenance/deletion cost analysis has no subject; binds if an accelerator is proposed (post-V6 accelerator program).

V5-12.03.note: No ANN — the exact eligible scan cannot route unauthorized vectors into results (e33).

V5-12.04.note: Exact eligible scan is the shipped path — no filtered-ANN design to prove.

V5-12.05.note: k returned items never certificates top-k; approximate coverage must declare itself.

V5-12.06.note: Deadline-limited scans report partial; exact identifiers ride the postings lane, not vector recall.

V5-12.07.note: Deterministic bounded iteration matches the reference order (ties/Unicode included).

V5-12.08.note: Bound handling covers tokenization/repeats/ties under the pinned normalization.

V5-12.09.note: Exact lexical BM25 matches a naive reference implementation (test_lexical_bm25_matches_naive_reference).

V5-12.10.note: Conditional on a shipped accelerator — none exists (exact scan only), so the kill-switch/no-authority-changing fallback obligation has no object; binds the post-V6 accelerator program.

V5-13.01.note: Canonical quote bytes release only through fresh quote authorization + verified locators; corrupt bytes fail closed.

V5-13.02.note: Superseded items never present as current (lifecycle dominance verified); persisted conflict/supersession relations trigger kernel-governed dependency lookup — facade _label_conflict_groups ships labeled group membership; e37 passes unmarked (stale xfail removed 2026-09-22).

V5-13.03.note: Required conflict/condition/support groups pack atomically — a tiny budget omits the whole group and reports insufficiency rather than shipping a misleading half-group (e37 passes unmarked; e63 enforces the serialized byte budget).

V5-13.04.note: I1 counterevidence-first ships as opt-in machinery (recall manifest='counterevidence_first', pack manifest_mode) — the consumer default keeps safe extractive grouping with labeled conflict groups, so the opt-in rule currently holds. V6-03.02 adopts I1 as the default pack; the named ablation/safety/host-test justification it requires is owned by G6-03.

V5-13.05.note: Insufficiency labels derive from caller-visible evidence; hidden contrary items change no flag/count/warning.

V5-13.06.note: contrary roles/counts describe only authorized observable members.

V5-13.07.note: Default search returns evidence hits — no unrequested generated answer.

V5-13.08.note: Serialized budget includes wrappers/warnings; enforced end-to-end (e63).

V5-13.09.note: Output screening + group-level repacking inherited on the governed lane — corrupt bytes fail closed everywhere (e36); consumer-route group revalidation exercised via the conflict-group labeling tests.

V5-13.10.note: Result distinguishes not-found / pending / partial / insufficient / unavailable without a hidden-existence oracle.

V5-14.01.note: Replacement retains old bytes, appends a revision, records intent/actor, applies under expected-version + epoch fences atomically.

V5-14.02.note: MemoryRef binds expected predecessor revision + control version; stale/foreign/erased refs fail, never rebind.

V5-14.03.note: Failed replacement authorization/validation does not partially supersede.

V5-14.04.note: Ordinary add/infer/duplicate text never implies lifecycle approval — retirement language yields a proposal only.

V5-14.05.note: Hypothetical/quoted/future/negated/ambiguous-subject twins produce no proposals or candidates.

V5-14.07.note: Unresolved candidates feed support completeness through the same authority path (test_open_candidates_feed); a cache hit or source-only search cannot hide the obligation — e47/e48 revalidation measured.

V5-14.08.note: Bitemporal semantics: valid-time/known-at retained with current access/deletion respected.

V5-14.09.note: Initial add creates source revision + source-state binding atomically; 'active' = admitted source record.

V5-14.10.note: Approved replacement appends successor in the same revision chain, advances mutation head, increments control_version, works with infer=False/zero claims.

V5-14.11.note: Mutation CAS-compares predecessor revision + control version under the transaction; proposals never advance the approved head.

V5-14.12.note: supersede/effective_at: commit-time default, future effective time schedules eligibility (read-time evaluation, no wake-job dependency).

V5-14.13.note: correct records owner retraction over the declared interval; effective_at rejected for correct.

V5-14.14.note: Superseded/retracted revisions surface only as labeled historical/contrary; pending jobs recheck source-state before publication.

V5-14.15.note: All source-derived producer paths consult source_state (assert_publishable fences).

V5-14.16.note: Source-state metadata/relations join deletion closure; erasure can clear a head, never reactivate an older revision.

V5-15.01.note: inspect explains identity/revision/locators/producer/verification/ancestry/lifecycle without bypassing quote permission.

V5-15.02.note: Verification describes what was checked (digest/locator/attribution); never 'verified real-world fact'.

V5-15.03.note: forget(ref) = targeted suppression-and-closure through privacy services with CAS guard on head+control_version.

V5-15.04.note: Query-forget returns bounded preview + bound confirmation token; drifted selection rejected.

V5-15.05.note: Model-visible surface exposes only capture/recall; no query-delete/purge/review/grant rights.

V5-15.06.note: Post-suppression fences deny across source/claim/vector/cache paths immediately.

V5-15.07.note: ForgetResult distinguishes suppression committed / cleanup pending / complete / failed obligations.

V5-15.09.note: Managed-boundary erasure covers stale jobs and index build files (e46); unmanaged backups/remote recipients are documented outside the erasure boundary — the API never promises their physical destruction.

V5-15.10.note: Hold/quarantine reporting measured through the privacy path: suppressed material reports precise status + pending cleanup, never claims purge, never restores ordinary recall. A dedicated legal-hold facet on ForgetResult is not separately qualified — disclosed.

V5-16.01.note: Existing final-pack cache reused; dependency fingerprint extended to v5 projections/generations.

V5-16.02.note: Key/fingerprint binds caller class, scope narrowing, purpose, verbs, temporal/perspective semantics, causal reqs, policy/epochs.

V5-16.03.note: Readiness barrier runs before a cached answer satisfies a session search.

V5-16.04.note: Every cache delivery revalidates authority/heads/holds/suppression and mints the normal receipt.

V5-16.05.note: Admission memoization bound to one read transaction — between-recall holds are observed.

V5-16.06.note: Revocation/hold/purge races fenced at a documented linearization point before delivery.

V5-16.07.note: Partial/pending/degraded results never cached as definitive completed answers.

V5-16.08.note: Canonicalized query keys + conservative fingerprinting measured; fuzzy reuse stays off for identifiers, negation, changing current state, conflicts, and unproven semantic equivalence (e47/e48 family).

V5-16.09.note: Conditional on prefetch machinery — none exists on the consumer route, so there is no prefetch to bind; the host/caller/purpose-bound contract applies if the host profile lands prefetch.
